properties.evidence: The first real discontinuation, and the case that raised the question. Built, shipped, correct, used zero times in every project that had it; four served tools, the core module, the --content-path flag and both test files were removed for v0.27.0. Until this edge, the graph still said the capability was `realized`, its check `passing` and its requirements `accepted` — two days after the code was deleted. The Decision is the source because a discontinued thing has no successor to put there, which is exactly what made this look like it needed new vocabulary.
